verdict.rationale: Namecheap has no native automation versioning, review, or rollback feature. Its official Terraform provider does let DNS configuration be managed as code, including per-record resources so different owners can share a domain. That code could be versioned and reviewed in Git, with rollback done by re-applying earlier config using outside tools. missing for 10: native automation version history, built-in review/approval workflow, documented rollback mechanism, any evidence covering non-DNS automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an IaC review/rollback workflow.
